title: Lessons Drawn from Strong Demand for SG Youth Plan Co-living Pilot
what_it_is: Lessons Drawn from Strong Demand for SG Youth Plan Co-living Pilot

sections.label: Youth housing initiative interest
sections.summary: A good number of youths registered for 100 units, citing personal space and independent living, with take-up still being monitored.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: In line with what youths have been telling us, the initiative has drawn interest with a good number of youths registering for the 100 units available.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The most commonly cited reasons were consistent with feedback from our earlier engagements, which is to have more personal space and to experience independent living.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: We are still in the very early stages and will continue to monitor eventual take-up and glean further lessons on youths' needs, preferences and considerations for flexible accommodation options.

sections.label: Flexible accommodation complements public housing
sections.summary: The initiative complements rather than replaces public housing, as youths still aspire to own HDB flats and the Government explores flexible options.

sentences.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
sentences.text: Subsequent to the indication of interest, it will still require them to follow through in terms of getting information, screening, so on and so forth until they sign the contract, so we will update our numbers in due course.

sentences.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
sentences.text: I want to also mention that the initiative complements rather than replaces our public housing system.

sentences.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
sentences.text: Home ownership remains a key tenet of our social compact and our youths still continue to aspire to own their own Housing and Development Board flats.

sentences.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
sentences.text: The Government will continue to do so and support these ambitions, but at the same time is also exploring a wider range of flexible accommodation options to compliment the broader housing landscape and to meet different needs at different stages of life.
